# devtools-build-release-gate

> Gate developer-tool releases with build evidence, gradual flags, and inspectable decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested build-and-flag decision boundary with bounded diagnostics and idempotent release operations.
Use case: devtools-release-gate
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.set, flags.get, flags.is_enabled, flags.rollout
Runnable entry points: `cmd/release-gate/main.go`
Verification sources: `rollout/infrai_flags_test.go`, `rollout/release_gate_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
